main.description: Provision a sandbox or production tenant for a pilot/customer law firm. Creates the firm root DID (depth 1) under did:web:<slug>.lawfirm.gftd.ai, publishes did.json, registers the tenant row in vertex_lawfirm_tenant, links to the originating pilot lead, and emits the lawfirm.tenant.provisioned audit event. Idempotent on (slug, tier).

slug.description: Lowercase ASCII slug used as DNS host prefix and DID web segment. e.g. 'nishith'. Must match ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,15}$.

legalName.description: Firm legal name as it appears on letterhead. e.g. 'Nishith Desai Associates'.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country of firm HQ (IN, JP, SG, US, ...)

dataRegion.description: Hyperdrive / RisingWave shard region. Phase 1 = vultr-lax; vultr-mum gated on DPDP Phase-2 buildout.

tier.description: sandbox = pilot tier (USD 0, 90-day data retention on suspend). saas-prod = paid tier.

pilotLeadId.description: Optional. Links this tenant to vertex_lawfirm_lead.lead_id (e.g. 'nishith-desai-2026'). Required when tier = 'sandbox'.

adminEmail.description: Sponsor partner email for kickoff mail and account binding. Encrypted at rest (signal:v1).

consentRegion.description: Jurisdictions for which consent capture is required at matter intake (e.g. ['IN','EU','JP']). Drives DPDP / GDPR / APPI prompts.

xrpcEndpoint.description: https://lawfirm.gftd.ai (single shared appview); tenant scope via owner_did filter on every read

kpiDashboardUrl.description: https://kpi-lawfirm.gftd.ai/<slug> — per-tenant view over view_lawfirm_funnel_snapshot et al.

racicDocUri.description: URI of the auto-generated W1-W12 RACI doc (gen-pilot-raci.py output).

status.description: created = new tenant; already_exists = idempotent re-call returned existing row; promoted = sandbox→saas-prod transition.

errors.name: SlugTaken
errors.description: slug already provisioned for a different legalName + country combination

errors.name: RegionUnavailable
errors.description: dataRegion not yet built out (e.g. vultr-mum pre-Phase-2)

errors.name: PilotLeadMissing
errors.description: tier=sandbox but no matching vertex_lawfirm_lead row found
